why: P13 wiring check of the gz wind (worlds/gusty.sdf + agent/gz_wind.py): steady 3 m/s east wind from t=0 of the wind step, then one 1-cosine gust +4 m/s, 2 s long, at t=25 s. Force law F = m c (v_wind - v), c = 1.0 1/s, predicts a steady tilt of atan(c 3 / g) = 17 deg into the wind and a peak near atan(7 / g) = 35 deg. PX4 default gains, MRL off.
